rules.build:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR"
for PROJECT in ffi-libarchive misc distro-info package repository; do ( cd $PROJECT bh_python_install --py3 --build ) done
rules.install:
PYTHON="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/python3"
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR"
for PROJECT in ffi-libarchive misc distro-info package repository; do mkdir -p "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$PROJECT"
( cd $PROJECT bh_python_install \ --py3 \ --install \ --root "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$PROJECT" )
if [ `ls "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$PROJECT/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/" | wc -l` -gt 0 ]; then sed -i "s|^#!/usr/bin/env python.*|#!$PYTHON|g" \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$PROJECT/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/"* fi done
